title: CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native
description:
Making AI control desktop software has always meant fragile screen-clicking or half-baked APIs. CLI-Anything fixes this. Point it at any software source code, and it runs a 7-phase automated pipeline that maps GUI actions to underlying code and generates a complete CLI wrapper with deterministic JSON output. Add it as a Claude Code plugin and your AI can edit videos, and control massive creative suites without ever seeing a screen.

https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything
